name: Athocrone
source:
Enjoy your dizzy trip to Cliffton, the town where everything is turned upside down.

Since childhood, Ciaran always wanted to leave their hometown. Failures kept chasing them in Cliffton, but the last one was so devastating that they had to give up on their dream and stay there for one more year.

It's now time to figure out who's their true friend and who's the enemy!

[From [url=https://urban-coven.itch.io/athocrone-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在Cliffton这个一切都颠倒错乱的小镇，开启一段令人晕头转向的旅程。

Ciaran从小就想离开故乡。失败一直在Cliffton纠缠着Ta，而最近一次打击尤为沉重，迫使Ta放弃梦想，再留在这里一年。

现在是时候弄清谁是真正的朋友，谁又是敌人了！

[摘自[url=https://urban-coven.itch.io/athocrone-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
